auth_environment.windows_process_scope_note: No persistent Kaggle credentials detected in ~/.kaggle/ or current process environment variables. On Windows, if KAGGLE_API_TOKEN was set via `set KAGGLE_API_TOKEN=...` in an earlier Command Prompt (cmd.exe) session, that variable is process-scoped to that specific cmd.exe window and is not inherited by new shells. Run scripts from that authenticated Command Prompt or run `kaggle auth login`.
